Friday Morning Richmond Park Laps

London, United Kingdom · Richmond Park · Road

Friday Morning Richmond Park Laps is a road group ride in London, United Kingdom. It rolls every Friday at 7:00 am local time from Colicci Roehampton Gate Café, Richmond Park (where the intro rides meet; members see the start for other rides). Pace: chilled / social pace on the Friday laps.

For visitors

Start with an intro ride (Auster Intro Rides on Meetup). Dark at 7:00 am from late October, so lights are needed. The club says ride leaders help you pick your speed group.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: chilled / social pace on the Friday laps.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Friday Morning Richmond Park Laps group ride

A weekly early-morning ride around Richmond Park for a South London club that runs rides at six speeds. The Friday laps are the chilled option, with coffee after. New riders can start with an intro ride and ride leaders help them pick a group.
